en: The Sutra on the Buddha’s Teaching of the Mantra for Curing Wind-Diseases:
Homage to the Buddha; homage to the Dharma; homage to the Sangha of Bhikṣus. Homage to the Seven Buddhas of the Past;
homage to all Buddhas of the Present; homage to all Buddhas of the Future; homage to the disciples of all Buddhas.
Son, cause my incantation to be fulfilled according to my wish:
Akhani nikhani akhaye nikha abiramandali parchini patilina namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namo saṃghāya.
Homage to the seven Buddhas of the past; homage to all Buddhas of the present; homage to all Buddhas of the future.
Homage to the disciples of the Buddhas; homage to all teachers; homage to the disciples of the teachers.
May my incantation be fulfilled according to my wish.
If a person contracts a seasonal epidemic,
one should tie a thread and recite the mantra over it seven times.
Write the names of these ghosts and spirits upon this [thread],
whether on paper or on mulberry bark,
and tie them to the ends of the threads.
one should observe the fast and maintain purity, wash and rinse oneself, burn incense,
and then recite it with a focused mind.
The Sutra on the Buddha’s Teaching of the Mantra for Curing Diseases of Wind (Vāta) Spoken by the Buddha.
